headline: Fire, wood, and a long table
story: Ember & Oak began as a pop-up in a borrowed kitchen — one grill, two cooks, and a short list of dishes that changed every night.
Today we still cook over live fire. Our menu is short on purpose: fewer plates, better produce, and enough time to get the crust right.
We work with farms within a few hours of the city, bake our own bread, and keep the dining room small so service stays personal.

values.title: Live fire
values.text: Most of the menu touches flame — grill, hearth, or ember-roasted vegetables.

values.title: Season first
values.text: We rewrite dishes when the market does. If it is not here yet, it is not on the plate.

values.title: Unhurried nights
values.text: No rush tickets for two-tops. Come for dinner, not a stopwatch.

team.name: Maya Chen
team.bio: Former line cook turned fire obsessive. Leads the kitchen and the weekly market runs.

team.name: Leo Hart
team.bio: Builds the list, greets the room, and makes sure every table finds the right bottle.

team.name: Sofia Reyes
team.bio: Honey, chocolate, and fruit that tastes like it was picked that morning.
